title: sebelum — before
pattern: A sebelum B · Sebelum B, A · sebelum jam …
explanation: sebelum means before, followed by an action or a time: sebelum makan (before eating), sebelum jam lima (before five o'clock). The verb after it never changes, so sebelum makan covers before I eat, before eating and before we ate. It can come after the main part, or first with a comma: Sebelum tidur, saya biasanya baca buku. It often pairs with dulu (first): Saya cuci tangan dulu sebelum makan. Going somewhere needs no verb: sebelum ke Indonesia, before going to Indonesia.
natural: Any register. Very common in instructions (minum obat sebelum makan), routines and plans.
stiff: Before at the end of an English sentence (I've been here before) isn't sebelum: say Saya pernah ke sini, or use sebelumnya (before that, previously).

examples.indonesian: Saya cuci tangan dulu sebelum makan.
examples.english: I'll wash my hands before I eat.

gap.why: Washing comes first, then eating: sebelum makan. dulu (first) often goes with it.

examples.indonesian: Saya harus pulang sebelum jam lima.
examples.english: I have to be home before five.

gap.why: Before a time is sebelum: sebelum jam lima. sampai would mean until.

examples.indonesian: Sebelum tidur, saya biasanya baca buku.
examples.english: Before bed, I usually read a book.

gap.why: Reading comes first, then sleep: Sebelum tidur, before bed.

examples.indonesian: Sebelum ke Indonesia, saya belajar sedikit bahasa Indonesia.
examples.english: Before coming to Indonesia, I learned a little Indonesian.

gap.after: ke Indonesia, saya belajar sedikit bahasa Indonesia.
gap.why: The learning came first: sebelum ke Indonesia, before going to Indonesia, with no verb needed.
